_doc: THE ENRICHMENT REGISTER — which served surfaces depend on an enrichment
source, and what THIN means for each.
Why this file exists. Until 2026-08-14 nothing in this product recorded
that a surface needed enrichment, so a section built without a scan and a
section built with one rendered identically. The measured consequence: one
client's technology register served 12 rows against another's 51, its own
empty_state said 'the technographic scan that would normally widen this
register did not run', and no surface, gate, checker or routine read that
sentence. The section was honest and the reader could not tell.
Two sources, per the build owner's adjudication of 2026-08-14 ('Both'):
explorium  a machine technographic scan at INGEST, so a scheduled run
gets a full register with no connector. Not yet live — it
needs an API key — and records NOT_RUN with that reason
until it is, which this register then renders.
clay       the producer session's enrichment, for contact routes,
thought leadership and firmographic members. Only available
where the session holds the connector: this organisation's
trigger API refuses connector grants, so scheduled runs
cannot use it and must say so rather than appear complete.
`thin_below` is a COUNT, deliberately, not a percentage: a rate needs a
denominator this product does not have (nobody knows how many products a
firm runs). The counts are floors set by measurement of the corpus, not by
aspiration — the reference client clears every one of them and the
under-enriched client clears none.
Nothing here judges a run. The API computes `enrichment_status` per section
from these floors and the rows actually served (invariant 8 — counted, never
stored); the surface then states which of its sources ran. A section below
its floor is not a failure, it is a section whose reader is told why it is
short.
RAN IS OBSERVABLE ONLY WHERE A ROW CAN CARRY THE MARK (2026-08-15).
`ran` asks whether an enrichment source contributed, and the API answers it
from the rows, never from an assertion — a producer claiming a scan ran while
no row shows it would be believed by any check that read a boolean. That
works where enrichment leaves a trace only enrichment could leave: a
`detection_basis` on a technology row, a contact route on a leadership row.
It does not work everywhere, and the first version of this file pretended
otherwise. Three surfaces — firmographics, sentiment, thought leadership —
declared a source and no way to observe it, so `enriched` was 0 for every
run that has ever existed and `ran` was false by construction. The badge that
read off it told every reader that a scan had not run on surfaces where no
payload could ever have said otherwise. That is invariant 9 exactly: a
default that looks like data.
The cause is not an oversight in the register, it is the shape of the
evidence. The synthesis skill requires citing the SOURCE, not the tool — a
filing Clay surfaced and a filing a search surfaced are the same filing and
produce an identical row. So on those three surfaces the question is not
false, it is unanswerable, and the honest serve is null.
Therefore every surface here MUST declare one of the two, and a surface that
declares neither fails test_enrichment_register_declarations:
basis_key / contact_keys   the row-level mark that evidences enrichment
ran_observable: false      + ran_unobservable_reason, and `ran` serves null
`counts` names the payload's own list key and is checked against the section
contract by the same test. It has to be: this file said `employee` for
sentiment against a section whose list is `bars`, so a card with seven rated
bars served count 0 and thin true, while the connector's SG-S8 passed the
same seven. Renderer and gate disagreed for as long as the feature existed
because the container name was written twice and compared nowhere.

techstack.techstack.thin_reason: no machine technographic scan has widened this register, so the rows here are only those a human search could place
techstack.techstack.closes_with: an Explorium scan at ingest, or a Clay Tech Stack scan in a producer session that holds the connector

overview.leadership.thin_reason: the contact-enrichment ladder established a route for fewer than half the named leaders
overview.leadership.closes_with: a Clay contact search against the entity's own domain, cited to the document it surfaces

overview.thought_leadership.ran_unobservable_reason: an entry is {kind, headline, quote, url, e_id} — the same row whether Clay's thought-leadership pass surfaced the post or the newsroom rung of the ladder did. Nothing on it distinguishes the two.
overview.thought_leadership.thin_reason: fewer than three named executives were established in their own words
overview.thought_leadership.closes_with: a Clay Find Thought Leadership pass, plus the newsroom and trade-press rungs of the ladder

overview.sentiment.ran_unobservable_reason: a bar is {source, rating, scale, n, as_of, url, e_id} — an App Store lookup and an employer-review export produce the same shape, and the row names the review site, never the route that reached it.
overview.sentiment.thin_reason: no retrievable rating carrying its sample size, scale and date was established
overview.sentiment.closes_with: an employer-review export or a client-satisfaction survey the firm publishes itself

overview.firmographics.ran_unobservable_reason: every field cites the filing it was read from, per the skill's own rule that the source is evidence and the tool is not. A Clay-surfaced call report and a searched one are one row.
overview.firmographics.thin_reason: fewer than nine of the must-present members carry a stated value
overview.firmographics.closes_with: a Clay company enrichment, cited to the filings and pages it surfaces rather than to Clay itself
